reuse_rule: use only the selected target's already-spent frozen SUCCESS output and its native parsing_res_list; never call a model
native_json_binding: page_markdown must byte-equal the frozen raw output whose SHA-256 is in the frozen manifest
geometry_conversion: floor left/top and ceil right/bottom from model pixels to bbox1000, clamped to 0..1000
region_match: source bbox center must be inside a non-empty model block; choose the unique smallest containing block; equal-area ties are unresolved
verification: every frozen target critical-token hash must have exactly the same multiplicity in the source region and matched model block
verification_scope: declared critical tokens in one source-bound region only
